answer: A fingerprint escrow stops bulk fakes: each agent locks 2x its 30-day earnings, released after 20 epochs. Each epoch it sends a pulse of tasks done, peers met, and timing matching its history. A hollow pattern, many accounts with identical timing and no real work, forfeits the escrow. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits plus 100 histories. One honest agent pays once, keeps a record like a willow, and recovers its bond for undiluted rewards.
